notes:
Purpose: lightweight prep for the weekly SRE ops sync. Keep this short — talking points, open questions, risk flags and owners.

Top-level focus this week:
- SLO drift on embeddings-service (p50 stable, p95 tail increasing) — likely related to recent kernel change on Dedicated pools.
- Pager volume +28% week-over-week, most pages are transient errors in hosted-api routing path (timeouts from model variant fallback).
- Two moderate incidents to summarize: INC-2026-112 (model routing memory leak; partial mitigation deployed 06-12), INC-2026-108 (KV cache cold starts during autoscale burst).

Things to validate before sync:
- Do we have a clear rollback plan for the kernel change? Who signs off (infra + platform)?
- Confirm whether rate-limiter tweaks last week contributed to increased tail latency for small requests.
- Verify postmortem draft for INC-2026-112 is started and that on-call logs are preserved.

Unresolved questions / hypotheses:
1) Hypothesis: memory leak only surfaces on pools > 4 GPUs due to a rare buffer fragmentation path. Need flamegraph from reproducer.
2) Hypothesis: cold KV cache is dominating p99 for embedding lookups when traffic spikes after cold start; is our warmup heuristic sufficient?
3) Are we seeing correlated errors across regions or only us-west-2? Quick region check required.

Parking lot (not for weekly sync unless requested):
- Propose an experiment to pre-warm KV cache during scale-up windows for Dedicated bursts (A/B test on small pool).
- Long-term: introduce a lightweight agent that reports heap-snapshots on schedule for high-memory processes.

Tone & ask: be pragmatic, call out triage owners, avoid deep technical rabbit holes in the main sync. Use breakout if needed.

Tiny personal reminders (notes-to-self):
- Bring the graph that overlays rate-limiter changes with p95 latency (time series + dotted annotate).
- Print incident timeline (06-11 02:14 first alert -> 06-12 09:05 mitigation).
- Remind infra lead to surface kernel-change PR and risk assessment in sync.
